description: This Java interface defines the context for handling HTTP push responses within the Eclipse Ditto project, specifically for messaging over HTTP. It encapsulates logic to process a response from an HTTP endpoint when publishing an external message.

classes.name: HttpPushContext
classes.description: A functional interface representing the context for HTTP push messaging, specifically for handling responses from an HTTP endpoint after message publication.

methods.name: onResponse
methods.description: Handles the HTTP response from the endpoint, passing the response wrapped in a Try, allowing for success or failure handling.
